note: Where every shipped dataset comes from and how far it can be trusted. build.cjs adds each file's real modification time, so freshness is measured rather than claimed. kind drives how the app words itself: 'operator' data may be stated plainly, 'community' and 'scraped' must be labelled.

kinds.operator: Published by the transport operator. Exact; may be stated without qualification.
kinds.official: Published by a public authority, but not the operator's own timetable.
kinds.community: OpenStreetMap. Real, but coverage is uneven and there are no timetables — must be labelled.
kinds.scraped: Read from a provider's web page with no open-data licence. Accurate when fetched, no guarantee of continuity.
kinds.curated: Compiled by hand for this project from published sources. Subject to human error and to change.
